transcript.text: During my reconciliation of the late-produced onboarding export against the user-agreement database, I confirmed that exactly 312 of the 480 putative class members have executed agreements containing an arbitration provision. The remaining 168 do not have arbitration provisions. This means we can only compel arbitration for roughly 65% of the putative class, and the other 168 members would remain in the litigation unless we develop a separate strategy for them. I have not yet incorporated this reconciliation into the formal arbitration analysis, but it clearly affects our posture and the viability of a clean arbitration-based resolution for the entire class.
